presentation.description: Keep a spear poised between the enemy and your company, striking with greater accuracy and extending your reach when you spend an action point. With experience, careless movement and ranged attacks within that reach become chances to deal damage, while powerful thrusts push troublesome foes away. presentation.description: Hunt as a company, closing quickly and giving your companions the actions and movement they need to surround the prey. You can spend your own action point on an ally's turn in the spotlight, while cunning attacks lure enemies into striking each other and expose a victim to an ally's follow-up. When the formation needs to change, you can scatter willing companions clear of danger or sustain a veil of concealment over the whole pack.

presentation.description: Lead with a fearless surge, lending force and accuracy to your companions when you spend an action point. Your inspiring word can urge a wounded ally into a stronger attack, though a failed opening leaves that ally exposed, and your killing stroke can set off a chain of attacks as companions bring down foes in turn. Resistance to fear and enemy marks helps you keep moving, while your greatest maneuver carries you through several enemies in a storm of individual blows.
